map.固废产生系数估算 使用指南: Solid Waste Generation Coefficient Estimator User Guide
map.基于行业产排污系数手册，输入产品产量估算固体废物产生量，用于工业企业固废管理与合: Based on industry generation and discharge coefficient manuals, enter the product output to estimate solid waste generation, for industrial solid waste management and compliance accounting reference.
map.固废产生量 = 产品产量 × 产污系数；回收量 = 总量 × 回收比例；处置量: Solid waste generated = output × generation coefficient; recovered = total × recovery share; disposed = total × disposal share; stored = total − recovered − disposed (clamped at zero)
map.产污系数取行业典型值（kg/单位）：煤炭采选 300、金属矿采选 1000、钢铁: Generation coefficients use typical industry values (kg per unit): coal mining and dressing 300, metal ore mining and dressing 1000, steel smelting 400, thermal power 250, chemicals 150, building materials 50, papermaking 200, textiles 60, food processing 100; you can switch to "custom" and enter your own. Totals are in kg, switching to tonnes at ≥1000 kg; recovery and disposal split the flow by percentage and the remainder is storage/emission, for industrial solid waste ledgers and compliance accounting.
map.行业测算：录入产量与单位产废系数，求固废量。: Industry estimate: enter the output and the waste factor per unit to get the solid waste amount.
map.治理规划：对不同行业录入参数，汇总区域总量。: Treatment planning: enter parameters for different industries and total the regional amount.
map.教学演示：演示系数法在宏观估算的简便性。: Teaching demo: show the convenience of the coefficient method for macro estimates.
map.：示例：产钢 100 万 t、吨钢产废系数 0.3 t，固废≈30 万 t（需按: : Example: 1 million t of steel at a 0.3 t of waste per tonne of steel gives about 300000 t of solid waste (adjust for the actual composition).
map.行业平均水平，工艺先进者更低；精确需实测，规划级用系数足够。结果按公开标准与环境: The industry average is used, with advanced processes lower; precision requires measurement, and coefficients are enough at the planning level. Results are estimated with public standards and environmental factors for science communication, teaching, and emission reduction estimates; for formal accounting follow the official guidelines (such as the GHG Protocol and provincial emission factors) and measured data.
map.一般固废与危废分列，危废须单独按名录管理，不可混算。结果按公开标准与环境因子估算: General solid waste and hazardous waste are listed separately; hazardous waste must be managed on its own catalogue and must not be mixed in. Results are estimated with public standards and environmental factors for science communication, teaching, and emission reduction estimates; for formal accounting follow the official guidelines (such as the GHG Protocol and provincial emission factors) and measured data.
